title: 美债回购加码：竟只是战术动作，长期收益率压力未解
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The former San Luis Fed President, Jim Bullard, joins us now for more.
segments.zh: 前圣路易斯联储主席布拉德现在加入我们，带来更多分析。

segments.en: Jim, I just want your reaction to the initial move from Treasury just a moment ago.
segments.zh: 吉姆，我想听听你对财政部刚刚宣布的初步举措的看法。

segments.en: Does this help bring some stability to this bond market?
segments.zh: 这有助于为债券市场带来一些稳定吗？

segments.en: Well, the market reaction suggests that this is an important tactical move from the Treasury a little bit unexpected
segments.zh: 嗯，市场反应表明这是财政部的一次重要战术性举措，有点出乎意料。

segments.en: so you're probably getting an outsized reaction right now.
segments.zh: 所以现在可能反应过度了。

segments.en: But I don't think it changes the fundamentals of big fiscal deficits and a Fed on the sidelines, which is what's driving longer term yields higher.
segments.zh: 但我认为这不会改变巨额财政赤字和美联储按兵不动的基本面，这些才是推高长期收益率的原因。

segments.en: Just on the deficits and on the supply, more specifically, Jim, think there's a belief that this might be the first step of maybe a few steps and the next step might be
segments.zh: 关于赤字和供应，吉姆，有人认为这可能是第一步，接下来可能会再次收紧长期债券的发行。

segments.en: to tighten up issuance at the long end of the curve again.
segments.zh: 再次收紧长期债券的发行。

segments.en: Would you assume that's the direction of travel now into the next quarterly refunding later on this year?
segments.zh: 你认为这是今年晚些时候下一次季度再融资的方向吗？

segments.en: Yeah, you could see that and markets would have to react to that and of course supplies is critically important
segments.zh: 是的，你可以看到这一点，市场必须对此做出反应，当然供应至关重要。

segments.en: for the traders. But I don't think for the macro economy, that doesn't change the fundamentals on employment 4.1%,
segments.zh: 对交易者而言，但我不认为对宏观经济，这不会改变就业率4.1%的基本面

segments.en: you've got inflation on PCE basis, core PCE basis running over 3%, the committees still expecting over 3% at the end of this year,
segments.zh: PCE通胀和核心PCE通胀率超过3%，委员会仍预计今年年底将超过3%

segments.en: even with good inflation reports between now and then, you've got longer term yields,
segments.zh: 即使从现在到那时有良好的通胀报告，长期收益率仍将存在
